subject: Christopher Nolan
headline: christopher nolan's the odyssey opens to $264 million
body: it's universal's biggest opening this year, boosted by imax, which brought in over half the weekend's box office.
slide2: reviews have been near-ecstatic overall, but rotten tomatoes is also logging a stubborn wave of one- and half-star pans.

subject: Justin Bieber
headline: justin bieber's world cup song jumps 240% in streams
body: some fans said 'everything hallelujah' didn't fit the vibe, but it spiked hard right after the championship game.
slide2: bieber performed it at the world cup halftime show alongside burna boy and shakira, per burna boy's behind-the-scenes diary of the night.

subject: Chloe Fineman
headline: chloe fineman lands first role since leaving snl
body: she'll star in netflix's myron bolitar opposite jabari banks, his first show since bel-air.
slide2: jamie mcshane (task, wednesday) joins as a series regular too, alongside ben mckenzie in the cast.

subject: Adam Driver
headline: adam driver keeps turning down marvel, kevin feige says
body: feige has tried casting him for years, most recently amid x-men reboot rumors, but driver keeps saying no.
slide2: "it's a tradition to zoom with him and then he passes," feige said on the happy sad confused podcast.
